host_validation.real_sdk_header_syntax: esp-x32/2601 xtensa-esp32-elf-g++ -fsyntax-only with installed Arduino 3.3.12 and IDF 5.5.5 headers passed; existing hx_read_diag.h warnings only

resources.driver_heap: Allocated once in setup, exact runtime allocation not measured; allocation failure makes PCNT unavailable/NA.
resources.runtime_struct: Additional bounded handles and one pending proof included in aggregate static budget.

configuration.sck_baseline: GPIO function2, output signal256, OE1, push-pull/no-pull; original IE/OECTRL recorded. SDK default commonly flags24.
configuration.sck_allowed_change: IE enabled only. Typical BASE24 -> DRIVER29 -> READY/EVENT28. Original OECTRL0 or1 remains identical.
configuration.data: INPUT_PULLUP flags5, no output; original function/signal/drive unchanged.
configuration.rollback: Only restore known driver pull side effects to FLOATING/PULLUP_ONLY and verify. Unverified GPIO restoration or counter STOP sets sticky clock_blocked, so no further HX clocks. No silent remap.
configuration.periman: Raw IDF PCNT does not replace Arduino GPIO bus ownership.
configuration.filter: Explicitly disabled; no claimed analog or minimum-pulse capture guarantee.
configuration.sdk_guard: Exact IDF5.5.5 compile-time assertion; another SDK requires renewed overflow review.

observation.positive_control: At most8 existing read attempts, four accepted comparisons with zero mismatches. SCK total both edges50; DATA transition count compared with LOW -> sampled24bits -> postHIGH. Counter-alive only, not ADC truth.
observation.hold: First eligible LINK only, with positive control and EVENT GPIO checks. SCK starts before DATA; DATA stops before SCK, with independent CPU brackets and start/end GPIO samples.
observation.same_loop_exit: Late early-service completion/truncation stops counters inside captureHxFailure before same-loop serial service or next HX train.
observation.deadlines: Shared600s and existing20s LINK post deadline unchanged. Actual START bracket checked before each unit. Polling targets are not hard real-time limits.
observation.overflow: IDF5.5.5 pending compensation plus sticky callback. Only raw_count0..16383 can be valid. Greater raw values remain preserved but range-invalid, without claiming proven overflow. Compensated/latch/negative counts invalid. Window must be less than1s.
observation.immutable: No rearm/clear. Both slots, HXF and PCNT snapshot fixed before outer export. Late callbacks cannot mutate sealed public snapshot.
limits: MCU-side digital edge totals are not HIGH event counts, pulse widths, HX-side analog waveform or ADC truth.
Postcheck to PCNT start is an explicit early blind gap.
Positive-control and API overhead changes scheduling and can cause more early HXF missed points.
Zero valid edges do not prove continuous analog LOW.
Synchronous DUMP still blocks polling after snapshots freeze.
No automatic calibration and no restoration of historical RAM coefficients.

protocol.invalid_values: Unknown time/count is NA. An actual API raw_count can remain visible when invalid; derived valid_count is null unless its observation is validated.
